title: Organization
description: An organisation's legal identity and board: a company, foundation, association or cooperative. The earliest record naming its own eVault is that eVault's manifest. Titled "Company" until 2026-10; the schemaId is unchanged.

groupManifestEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope ID of the canonical GroupManifest

directors.description: eNames of the directors. Any one director may create roles and grant delegations; only an existing director may change this list. The creator is the first director.

address.description: Registered address: the legal seat, as registered in the jurisdiction. A visiting address is a different fact and does not belong here.

registrationNumber.description: Company registration number in its jurisdiction

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of registration, e.g. an ISO 3166 code

legalForm.description: Legal form in its jurisdiction, as registered, e.g. "BV", "stichting", "vereniging", "GmbH", "LLC".

foundingDate.description: Date the organisation was legally founded (YYYY-MM-DD).

iban.description: IBAN of the account payments to the organisation go to, without spaces. It is part of the signed record, so only a director can change it, and nobody can swap the account a payer sees without a director's signature.

statutesFileUri.description: The organisation's statutes (articles of association), as a w3ds://file URI.

authorization.description: The wallet signature, over this record's canonical form (`w3ds-grant/v1`), of the director who set or last changed `directors`: the creator for the first version, then an existing director. The eVault verifies it before accepting the write.

signedPayload.description: The exact canonical string that was signed
